body.name: R(\lambda),C_\alpha(\lambda)
body.construction: Define \(R(\lambda)=\inf_{D_{\lambda}\in\mathscr D_{\lambda}}\sup_{\rho\in[-r,r]}\mathbb E_{\lambda,\rho}|D_{\lambda}-(a-b\rho)|\). Define \(C_\alpha(\lambda)=\inf_{\mathcal C_\lambda\in\mathscr C_{\lambda}}\sup_{\rho\in[-r,r]}\mathbb E_{\lambda,\rho}\operatorname{len}(\mathcal C_\lambda)\), subject to \(\inf_{\rho\in[-r,r]}\Pr_{\lambda,\rho}\{a-b\rho\in\mathcal C_\lambda\}\ge1-\alpha\).
